title: YAPYAP controller map
note: Quest X (left lower) and Index left A duck. Right B grabs on both devices; in menus it goes back. Right A jumps/confirms. Left trigger toggles inventory; right stick press pauses. Index uses the same hand/button positions and actions as Quest. Custom SteamVR bindings can change this map. Index bindings are source verified; a physical Index headset/controller test is pending.

bindings.note: In inventory, tilt left/right to retrieve and down to switch hands. Return the stick to center between selections.
Press once to open or close settings/pause.
Squeeze and release to open or close inventory.
Voice spells use the headset microphone.
Disabled while inventory selection is open. Optional task list: left grip + left upper button; this also sends normal Use/Drop.
Alternative to right B. Look at the item first; keep holding for hold interactions. In inventory, a fresh squeeze stores the item.
Quest X matches Index left A. In gameplay: duck; in inventory: close; not a menu-confirm button.
Quest Y matches Index left B. Optional left grip + this button opens tasks, also sending Use/Drop.
Right A. In menus: confirm; in inventory: store the right-hand item.
Right B. In gameplay: grab/hold/interact. In inventory: store; in menus: go back.
Use right stick press. Grip + right B no longer pauses, so grabbing cannot open pause accidentally.

devices.context: Left X ducks; right B grabs. Inventory: left trigger toggles; tilt left/right to retrieve, down to swap hands. Right A/B or right grip stores. Left lower button or left trigger closes inventory. Right stick press pauses. In menus: right A confirms, right B goes back. Optional tasks: left grip + left upper button (also sends Use/Drop).
